integrity: The proof relies on cited published positive congruences. New negative cases follow from a reproducible exact coefficient table, and the all-parameter quantifiers from a proved formal factorization. No finite experiment is taken as an unrestricted proof.
scientific_limitations: Originality is limited to the negative/exhaustive converse and sharp two-sample decision test. Hirschhorn–Sellers previously proved all positive families and shifts. Higher prime powers and other progression steps are not asserted. Independent historical review is outstanding.
scientific_scope: All k>=1, residue r in 0..6, step seven, modulus seven. Exact classification and sharp two-coefficient iff.
title: Sharp two-coefficient recognition of mod-seven colored-odd partition congruences
